verdict.rationale: Supermemory is API-first, so it runs headlessly by design. It has official TypeScript and Python clients and documented code-level add/search calls that can be scripted from any automation environment. It also offers a self-hosted single binary with no Docker, database or config files, plus an `npx supermemory setup` CLI. Missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline documentation or examples, guidance on non-interactive API-key auth in CI, and independent or hands-on corroboration of automated use.
